interfaces.extensionContract: Hispania.ExtensionDemo.Contracts.IExtensionDemoV1: GetMessage() and WaitForMessageAsync(int, CancellationToken), used by test packages.
interfaces.selection: Hispania.Runtime.ICapabilityResolver resolves a typed contract inside a host process.
interfaces.oopTransport: ModuleWorkerProtocolV1 over a current-user-only named pipe; hello/negotiation binds module identity and launch token; request/response frames carry capability ID, version, operation, JSON payload and correlated response.
interfaces.executor: ModuleExtensionCapabilityExecutor invokes a trusted, active declared capability from the Worker Agent; it is not registered as a public endpoint in Core.

fiveBehaviorStages.stage: capability response delivered to a client through published Core
fiveBehaviorStages.evidence: Core has no capability invocation route and its ModuleExtensionCatalog is created with jobContributionRegistry null; no supported client path exists in this artifact.

security.coreManagement: Module reads require an authenticated Core session and ModuleReadPermission; mutations require ModuleManagePermission, same-origin validation and antiforgery.
security.oop: Current-user-only pipe, random per-launch token, module identity/protocol negotiation, declared capability and contract-type checks, bounded frames and request timeouts.
security.limitations: OOP is fault/resource isolation only, not a sandbox against malicious native code. No arbitrary public reflection invocation is exposed.
